{{Quote|This is all on Republic orders, of course, part of the big push&mdash;take a look at Regulation 235-R, you'll see that everything checks out. Have a good one.|Tanno Vik|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Regulation 235-R''' was an internal regulation in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] that dictated the size and positioning of improvised field latrines. [[Tanno Vik]] used the regulation as part of a bluff to commandeer a security team on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
